chunks.script: I need to get my hair cut.
chunks.translation: ฉันต้องไปตัดผมซักที
chunks: I need
to get my hair cut.

chunks.script: She had her car repaired at the garage.
chunks.translation: เธอเอารถไปซ่อมที่อู่
chunks: She had her car repaired
at the garage.

chunks.script: I'm going to get my phone screen fixed.
chunks.translation: ฉันจะเอาจอมือถือไปซ่อม
chunks: I'm going
to get my phone screen fixed.

chunks.script: We had the air conditioner serviced last month.
chunks.translation: เดือนที่แล้วเราเรียกช่างมาเช็คแอร์
chunks: We had the air conditioner serviced last month.

chunks.script: I need to get my eyes checked.
chunks.translation: ฉันต้องไปตรวจสายตาซักที
chunks: I need
to get my eyes checked.

chunks.script: She got her dress altered before the party.
chunks.translation: เธอเอาชุดไปแก้ก่อนงานปาร์ตี้
chunks: She got her dress altered before the party.

chunks.script: I had my laptop cleaned by a technician.
chunks.translation: ฉันให้ช่างทำความสะอาดแล็ปท็อปให้
chunks: I had my laptop cleaned by a technician.

chunks.script: We're getting the apartment repainted next month.
chunks.translation: เดือนหน้าเราจะให้เขาทาสีอพาร์ตเมนต์ใหม่
chunks: We're getting the apartment repainted next month.

chunks.script: I got my documents translated professionally.
chunks.translation: ฉันให้มืออาชีพแปลเอกสารให้
chunks: I got my documents translated professionally.

chunks.script: She had her photo taken by a professional photographer.
chunks.translation: เธอให้ช่างภาพมืออาชีพถ่ายรูปให้
chunks: She had her photo taken by a professional photographer.

chunks.script: You should get that mole checked by a doctor.
chunks.translation: คุณควรให้หมอตรวจไฝนั้นนะ
chunks: You should get
that mole checked by a doctor.

chunks.script: He got his passport renewed last week.
chunks.translation: อาทิตย์ที่แล้วเขาต่ออายุพาสปอร์ต
chunks: He got his passport renewed last week.

chunks.script: I need to have this package delivered by tomorrow.
chunks.translation: ฉันต้องให้ส่งพัสดุนี้ถึงภายในพรุ่งนี้
chunks: I need
to have this package delivered by tomorrow.

chunks.script: She had her nails done before the interview.
chunks.translation: เธอไปทำเล็บก่อนสัมภาษณ์งาน
chunks: She had her nails done before the interview.

chunks.script: We had our house cleaned before the guests arrived.
chunks.translation: เราให้คนมาทำความสะอาดบ้านก่อนแขกมา
chunks: We had our house cleaned before the guests arrived.
